title: On-Time Payment Record and the Rent Increase Limit: Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement
content:
The lateness reduction on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement follows the late fees posted on the agreement in the 12 months up to the handling date: none takes **two and a half percentage points** (2.5 points) off the limit percentage, one or two take **1 point** off, and three or more take nothing off. Points taken off never bring the limit percentage below zero (0 percent), so that a reduction never sets the rent below the rent before the increase.

The late fees are the late-fee entries on the agreement's ledger whose posting date falls within the 12 months up to the handling date.

| Late fees in the 12 months | Points off |
|---|---|
| 0 | 2.5 |
| 1 | 1 |
| 2 | 1 |
| 3 or more | none |

## Hypothetical case
A tenant with a single late fee posted 13 months before the handling date and none since has no late fee in the 12 months: 2.5 points off.
